figures.label: S3
figures.caption: Figure S3. (a) DSC curves of phase pure Li6PS5Cl and Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5. Phase pure Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 was synthesized at a lower temperature (480 ˚C) to get rid of exsolvation of LiCl impurity. The tiny amount of LiCl impurity exclusively influences the thermal stability of SEs, while the ionic conductivity and the electrochemical stability remain unchanged. Sharp melting/crystallization peaks were observed for Li6PS5Cl at 535/532 ˚C, respectively. For Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5, the melting/crystallization peaks turn broader and shift to lower temperature (523/493 ˚C). (b) TGA curves of phase pure Li6PS5Cl and Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5. No severe weight loss is observed for Li6PS5Cl whereas the weight of Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 drops from 315 ˚C.
